items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think that was either Grady or somebody else played drums on that record

ctx.x: Okay. Walking in Space and also Killer Joe, I think that was either Grady or somebody else played drums on that record – on that track. Then I know Freddie Hubbard did a solo, I did a solo, and they had the voices on Killer Joe. Walking in Space went through a lot of stuff, different rhythms. I think Purdie played on this thing – I played tenor saxophone, believe it or not, on one of those. Love and Peace?
